drifted.spec_text: During initialize(), after GPU and memory-tier are ready, the dispatcher MUST call IGpuServices::register_host_memory... The dispatcher SHOULD also cache block-device ClientChannels per data drive at init time to avoid per-operation connection overhead.
drifted.actual: DataDrive.cached_channels: Option<ClientChannels> (a single channel cached at init) has been replaced by DataDrive.channel_pool: ChannelPool. The pool starts empty at init -- no channel is connected eagerly -- and instead grows lazily on demand: each concurrent reader calls channel_pool.checkout() to obtain an exclusive, RAII-leased ClientChannels (connected on first checkout, drained of stale completions, returned to the pool on Drop). This was a deliberate fix for a hang: a single shared channel let two concurrent readers on the same drive (batch_lookup and the prefetch path) dequeue each other's NVMe completions ('completion theft'), which never timed out because the reads had already completed. The spec's 'single instance cached at init' model no longer matches the code.
drifted.location: components/dispatcher/src/lib.rs:110 (DataDrive.channel_pool), lib.rs:122-163 (ChannelPool/ChannelLease), lib.rs:641-642 (promote_and_serve checkout), lib.rs:752-754 (serve_cold_staged checkout), lib.rs:1525 (ChannelPool::new at init, no eager connect), lib.rs:2861-2876 (promote_to_memory_tier per-drive prefetch checkout)

drifted.actual: evict_for_space now frees one pin-safe victim per iteration via evict_one_clean, scanning a widening oldest_keys(4x attempts, cap 1024) window; each candidate is demoted (try_evict_to_block) or, if unpinned, dropped (dm.remove); pinned candidates are skipped. The blind evict_lru/evict_lru_for_key(target_key) fallback is removed -- target_key is unused. If every scanned candidate is pinned, returns AllocationFailed instead of freeing a pinned slot. evict_and_insert's fragmentation-relief path likewise uses evict_one_clean.

unspecced.feature: Per-drive ChannelPool / ChannelLease for concurrent cold-path readers: replaces the single per-drive cached channel with a lazily-grown pool of exclusive, RAII-leased ClientChannels; checkout drains stale completions so a recycled channel never matches an old op's tag against a new op's segments; connect_client runs outside the pool lock.
unspecced.suggested_spec: Rewrite FR-034's second sentence to describe the ChannelPool and the completion-theft hazard it fixes

unspecced.feature: Init-time partition-table compatibility guard: validates that a data drive's GPT has the expected 3 Certus partitions (metadata, extended metadata, data) before indexing table.partitions[0]/[2], returning a descriptive DispatcherError instead of panicking with an out-of-bounds index on a disk with a valid-but-non-Certus GPT.
